note: Landwirtschaftliche Rentenbank Group's disclosure report under Part Eight CRR as of 31 December 2015. Like the 2014 report resolved earlier, this predates the KM1 template - the figures sit in running prose and small tables. The three capital ratios are on p.27 in a table comparing 31 December 2015 with the prior year, and the 2014 column repeats 19.3 / 16.4 / 16.4, matching the 2014 answer. Total risk exposure of EUR 15,751m is on the same page. CET1 and Tier 1 ratios are equal because Rentenbank's own funds are almost entirely CET1. Capital amounts are deliberately not recorded: the report reconciles balance-sheet items to own funds rather than stating a clean CRR total, and deriving them from the ratios would be inventing figures. No leverage ratio, LCR or NSFR at this date.
